response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), group_stats AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count, AVG(invoice_count) AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(sc.invoice_count * 1.0 / gs.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(sc.invoice_count - gs.average_count) AS average_excess FROM state_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN group_stats AS gs WHERE sc.invoice_count > gs.average_count
